welcome.title: Welcome tour
welcome.homeBody: Your quick-access panel: reach Explore, Events, Favourites and Profile from one place.
welcome.exploreBody: Discover dance events near you on the map, with filters by style, type, date and price. Tap the map to move the search centre, and switch to satellite view whenever you like.
welcome.eventsBody: Browse every event as a list or calendar, and sort it however you like.
welcome.favoritesBody: See the events you organise and the ones you're attending, also as a list or calendar.
welcome.profileBody: Edit your details and preferences, and check your stats.
welcome.tipsSubtitle: A few more tips worth knowing.
welcome.tipFollow: Follow other users to hear about their new events.
welcome.tipAttend: Tap the heart icon on an event to join it and have it show up in your favourites.
welcome.tipReuse: Reuse a past event to quickly create its next edition, from the "Reuse" button on a finished event.
welcome.tipNotifications: The bell tells you about new followers, event changes and more.
welcome.tipPreferences: Seeing few events? Check your search preferences (style, type, location, distance, status...) - the more open they are, the more events show up.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.section1Body: DanceMeet is an app for discovering, organising and attending dance events, and for connecting with other people who share this passion. This policy explains what data we collect, what we use it for, and what control you have over it.
privacyPolicy.section2Body: When you register we store your name, email and password. You can optionally add your phone number, a profile photo, links to your social media (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, WhatsApp, website), your address and location, and your dance style and event type preferences.
privacyPolicy.section3Body: We use this data to show you relevant events and people based on your preferences and location, so other users can find and follow you, and to send you notifications about the activity you care about. We never sell your data to third parties.
privacyPolicy.section4Body: To search for events near you and calculate distances, we use your city and coordinates, obtained via your browser's geolocation or an address you enter manually. This lookup goes through our server, which queries Google's mapping service to turn addresses into coordinates.
privacyPolicy.section5Body: If you allow it, we send you push notifications (new followers, event changes, same-day reminders...) via Firebase Cloud Messaging. You can choose which notification types to receive, or turn them all off, from Settings.
privacyPolicy.section6Body: Your name, photo and dance styles are visible to other users. Your email, phone, city and location are only shown if you turn that specific option on in your Profile; they're hidden by default.
privacyPolicy.section7Body: You can review and update your data at any time from the Profile tab. If you'd like your account and data deleted, contact us and we'll take care of it.
privacyPolicy.section8Body: If we make a significant update to this policy, we'll let you know inside the app.

termsOfUse.title: Terms of Use
termsOfUse.section1Body: By creating a DanceMeet account you accept these terms of use. If you don't agree, please don't use the app.
termsOfUse.section2Body: You must be at least 16 years old to register. By creating an account you confirm that the information you provide is accurate and that you'll keep it up to date.
termsOfUse.section3Body: You're responsible for activity carried out from your account and for keeping your password safe. Let us know if you think someone has accessed it without your permission.
termsOfUse.section4Body: DanceMeet lets you discover dance events, create your own, follow other users and get notified about the activity you care about. We don't organise or oversee events published by other users.
termsOfUse.section5Body: Treat other users with respect. Harassment, impersonation, and posting false, offensive or illegal content are not allowed. We may remove content or accounts that break these rules.
termsOfUse.section6Body: Each event is the responsibility of whoever organises it - its description, conditions, safety and whether it actually takes place. DanceMeet doesn't guarantee the accuracy of published information or take part in organising events.
termsOfUse.section7Body: We may suspend or remove accounts that breach these terms, without prior notice in serious cases.
termsOfUse.section8Body: We may update these terms over time. If a change is significant, we'll let you know inside the app.
